entry.title: CVE-2026-115538 HIGH
entry.summary: Moby's overlay network driver does not restore the iptables rules for encrypted overlay networks after firewalld deletes them. Unlike other Docker Engine networking components, the overlay driver does not handle firewalld reload or start signals over D-Bus. entry.title: CVE-2026-97040 UNSCORED
